status: Hand-maintained mirror of the #[contractimpl]; verified by tests/abi_surface.rs. Not generated from a deployed wasm. v1 was never deployed.

functions.name: __constructor
functions.notes: Sets the contract admin (upgrade governance only; no power over pools)

functions.name: create_pool
functions.notes: Pool starts Active

functions.name: allow_member
functions.notes: Only before first deposit (MembershipFrozen after)

functions.name: join_pool
functions.notes: Hash must equal pool membership_policy_hash

functions.name: deposit
functions.notes: from = controller or joined member; fails closed if token moves a different amount

functions.name: issue_right
functions.notes: Rejects if reserved would exceed funded-claimed-withdrawn

functions.name: propose_transfer
functions.notes: One open proposal per right; refused once the right has matured (RightMatured); expiry must be > now and <= maturity; replacing an expired proposal emits transfer_cancelled for it

functions.name: accept_transfer
functions.notes: Single use; rejects expired/stale/matured; moves open_rights between the two members

functions.name: claim
functions.notes: At/after maturity, exactly once; allowed while paused or closed; voids an open proposal (emits transfer_cancelled first)

functions.name: withdraw_unreserved
functions.notes: Only value not reserved by any issued right; allowed while Active or Closed, not Paused

functions.name: pause_pool
functions.notes: Blocks deposit/issue/transfer/withdraw/membership changes; never claims. PoolClosed on a closed pool

functions.name: close_pool
functions.notes: Terminal. From Active or Paused. Blocks deposits, members, issuance and transfers; claims, cancellations, leaving and unreserved withdrawals remain

functions.name: remove_member
functions.notes: Only before first deposit (MembershipFrozen after); clears allow-list entry and membership

functions.name: leave_pool
functions.notes: Refused while the member owns an unclaimed right (MemberHasRights); sets eligible=false

functions.name: propose_controller
functions.notes: Step 1 of rotation; replaces any earlier proposal

functions.name: accept_controller
functions.notes: Step 2 of rotation

functions.name: propose_admin
functions.notes: Step 1 of admin rotation

functions.name: accept_admin
functions.notes: Step 2 of admin rotation

functions.name: propose_upgrade
functions.notes: Timelock UPGRADE_DELAY_SECS = 604800; one pending at a time; refused after lock_upgrades

functions.name: execute_upgrade
functions.notes: Only at/after executable_after; storage preserved; emits contract_upgraded

functions.name: lock_upgrades
functions.notes: Irreversible; cancels a pending upgrade

functions.name: get_member
functions.notes: NotMember if never joined (or removed)

functions.name: get_counts
functions.notes: Highest ids issued so far

invariant: reserved >= 0 and reserved <= funded - claimed - withdrawn after every call
upgradePolicy: Admin-only, two-step admin rotation, 7-day timelock announced on-chain (upgrade_proposed), cancellable, permanently lockable (lock_upgrades). The admin has no authority over pools, rights or tokens.
